English_to_Mauritian Creole.input: Then the disciples understood that Jesus was talking to them about John the Baptist.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.reference: Lerla bann disip konpran ki Zezi ti pe koz ar zot lor Zan Batis.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.prediction: Lerla so bann disip konpran ki Zezi ti pe koze ar Zan Batis.

English_to_Mauritian Creole.input: But never the impact of a fallen object in the sky had produced a flash of light like that of September 11, 2013, when a meteorite landed in the Sea of Clouds - at a speed of 61,000 km /h.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.reference: Me zame linpak enn obze tonbe depi lesiel pa finn prodwir enn flas lalimier kouma seki 11 septam 2013, kan meteorit la finn aterir dan enn lamer niaz -  enn vites 61,000 km/h.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.prediction: Me zame li pa ti ena enn lanplasman kouma le 11 Set 2013 kan enn meteorit ti tom lor lamer laleng - ar enn vites 61,000 km/h.

English_to_Mauritian Creole.input: These first records were made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.reference: Ti fer sa premie resansman la letan Kirinyis ti gouverner provins Lasiri.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.prediction: Sa bann premye rekord la ti fer kan Quirinius ti gouverner Sirie.

English_to_Mauritian Creole.input: And so in the future world, when the Son of Man sits on his glorious throne, I promise that you will sit on twelve thrones to judge the twelve tribes of Israel.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.reference: Dan sa nouvo lemonn la, kan Garson Limanite pou asiz lor so tronn dan laglwar, mo promet zot kii zot pou asiz lor douz tronn pou ziz douz tribi Izrael.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.prediction: Apre, kan Garson Limanite asir so tronn dekonstriksion, mo pou dir zot, zot pou asir zot tronn dan zot lizour.

English_to_Mauritian Creole.input: I will send prophets and wise people and experts in the Law of Moses to you.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.reference: Mo pou avoy zot bann profet, bann saz ek bann vre profeser lalwa Moiz.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.prediction: Mo pou avoy bann profet, bann savan ek bann expert dan lalwa Moiz.

English_to_Mauritian Creole.input: Abu says, “then there was a medium sized rock, it had two ears but didn’t have any horns”.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.reference: Abu dir “Lerla ti ena enn ros mwayen, ena de zorey, me pena korn”.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.prediction: Abu dir, “Apre ti ena enn ros mwayen, li ti ena de zorey me pa ti ena korn”.

English_to_Mauritian Creole.input: A teacher of the Law of Moses came up to him and said, Teacher, I'll go anywhere with you.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.reference: Enn profeser lalwa Moiz apros ar li e dir li, profeser mo pou swiv twa ninport ki kote to ale.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.prediction: Enn profeser lalwa Moiz vinn kot li pou dimann li, Mouton, mo pou al laba avek twa.

English_to_Mauritian Creole.input: The owner answered one of them, friend, I didn't cheat you.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.reference: Propriyeter la reponn enn ladan, kamarad, mo pa finn fer trik twa.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.prediction: Patrona reponn enn-la, kamarad, mo pa finn kraz to larzan.

English_to_Mauritian Creole.input: And what about the four thousand people and all those baskets of leftovers from only seven loaves of bread?
English_to_Mauritian Creole.reference: E zot pa rapel sa set dipin ki ti nouri sa kat mil zom la ek sa kantite panie plin ki zot ti ramase la?
English_to_Mauritian Creole.prediction: E kouma pou fer ar kat milyon dimounn ek tou bann bann restan depi selman set dipin?

English_to_Mauritian Creole.input: He looked up towards heaven and blessed the food.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.reference: Li lev so lizie ver lesiel e li beni manze-la.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.prediction: Li ti get otour lespas e li ti benir manze.

English_to_Mauritian Creole.input: When you begged for mercy, I said you did not have to pay back a penny.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.reference: Mo finn rey tou to det parski to finn sipliy mwa.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.prediction: Kan zot ti dimann mwa pardonn zot, mo ti dir zot pa pou bizen retourn enn sou.

English_to_Mauritian Creole.input: Any kingdom where people fight each other will end up ruined.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.reference: Enn rwayom ki divize kont limem, li enn rwayom fini.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.prediction: Kan dimoun lager ar lezot dimoun, zot pou fini fini.

English_to_Mauritian Creole.input: And I am not good enough even to stoop down and untie his sandals.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.reference: E mo pa ase bon, pou mo kourbe devan li, pou larg so sandalet.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.prediction: E mo pa bon ase pou zet mo lapo e desouy so soukoup.

English_to_Mauritian Creole.input: Who among you, if your son asks for bread, you will give him a stone?
English_to_Mauritian Creole.reference: Kisannla parmi zot, ki si so garson dimann dipin, li pou donn li enn ros?
English_to_Mauritian Creole.prediction: Kisannla parmi zot, si zot garson dimann to donn li dipin, to pou donn li enn ros?

English_to_Mauritian Creole.input: If that person listens, you have won back a follower.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.reference: Si sa dimounn la ekoute, to pou finn regagn li kouma to frer.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.prediction: Si dimounn-la ekoute, to finn gagn enn nouvo disip.

English_to_Mauritian Creole.input: Then he pointed to his disciples and said, these are my mother and my brothers.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.reference: Lerla li montre zot so bann disip e li dir, ala mo mama ek mo bann frer.
English_to_Mauritian Creole.prediction: Lerla li ti dir zot, sa bann la, zot mama ek zot frer.
